lines.say: Everyone's blurting right now. Most people skip the part that makes it work.
You write down everything you remember. Then you shut the book, and move on.
But the gaps are the whole point. Check what you missed, and go back to it.
Offload does blurting from your own notes. You write it all down, then it shows you the gaps.
And when you open it tomorrow, it tells you what to do next.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
